newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam airport waves fees for rare Gazelles.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam airport waves fees for rare Gazelles.

text.p: Five rare Ibex gazelles are to be flown from the Netherlands to Austria, Rotterdam Airport said.
The animals, which were bred in Amsterdam's Artis zoo, will leave the Dutch airport tomorrow on a special charter flight bound for Innsbruck with the Austrian airline Tyrolean Air Ambulance.
Rotterdam said the animals - three bucks and two does - will be flown in Dornier 328 as part of a programme to re-establish the creatures in the Austrian Alps.
Rotterdam Airport said it is supporting the repatriation programme by waiving landing fee charges to the charter parties, Artis and the Innsbruck Alpenzoo.
